zh.text: 如果人類能像壁虎一樣爬牆？
你會變成什麼樣子？
秘密在腳趾：沒有膠水，也沒有吸盤。
每平方毫米，一萬四千多根細毛，
每根再分岔成數百個奈米刷頭。
一隻五十克的壁虎，理論上能吊起一百三十三公斤，
差不多兩個大人。
那人類照抄不就好了？
身體放大兩倍，體重變八倍，腳底只變四倍。
越大隻的動物，腳墊佔身體越多，
壁虎是蟎的兩百倍。
壁虎可能就是極限了。
換成人類，
你百分之四十的皮膚，都得是黏腳墊。
全長在腳上，就是歐碼一百四十五號，
一隻鞋將近一公尺。
或者，全長在正面：
百分之八十的正面都是黏墊，
整個人貼在牆上爬。
你百分之四十的皮膚，都得是腳底。
爬牆這種事，還是交給壁虎吧。

en.text: What if humans could climb walls like geckos?
What would you look like?
The secret is in the toes. No glue, no suction cups.
14,400 hairs per square millimeter,
each splitting into hundreds of nano-tips.
A 50-gram gecko could, in theory, hold 133 kilograms.
About two adults.
So why not just copy the gecko?
Twice the size means 8 times the weight, but only 4 times the soles.
The bigger the animal, the more of it is pad.
A gecko's is 200 times a mite's.
Geckos may be the size limit.
Now, a human.
40 percent of your skin would have to be sticky pads.
Put it all on your feet: EU size 145.
Each shoe almost a meter long.
Or put it all on your front.
80 percent of it, all sticky pad.
You'd climb hugging the wall.
40 percent of your skin would be feet.
Wall climbing? Leave it to the geckos.
